title: pm: the carried-record regeneration test lists a renamed path by its destination only, so a hop that moves a reviewed file out of its face is not seen
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (an out-of-diff observation of the at-tier delta review 6887175399 of PR #33531, card #33501; its in-diff twin is should-fix SF2 there). `reach:` a carried contract-review record can survive a regeneration hop that moved a reviewed file out of the reviewed face, because the hop's rename is listed by its destination only.

**What is wrong.** `unexplainedPathsBetween` in `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (on `main`, the `names` helper inside it) lists a hop's changed paths with `git diff -z --name-only FROM TO` and no `--no-renames`. With rename detection on (git's default), a rename is listed by its destination path only. The review measured this on git 2.43 in a throwaway repository: moving `skills/a/rules/security.md` to `content/docs/security.md` lists only the docs path. A hop that renames a reviewed file to a path that `base` explains, or that the carry otherwise admits, therefore never shows the removed source path, and the carried record can stand for a head where a reviewed file has left its face.

**What lands.** Pass `--no-renames` to every `--name-only` diff the carry machinery reads (this helper and any sibling), so a rename reads as a delete plus an add. Pin it with one self-test case that runs real git in a temporary repository (the fake git readers in the battery cannot see what git lists), plus an argument pin. The guard's row enumeration in `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` already passes `--no-renames`; PR #33531 fixes its own new call (SF2).

`scripts/pm/**` only, `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no`.

Dedupe (open AND closed): `is:issue unexplainedPathsBetween` and `is:issue no-renames carried record` → none. **New.**
